newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 973 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 973 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 973 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 69 wheat, 328 corn, 476 soybean, 58 soymeal and 42 soyoil futures contracts traded along with 2 wheat call, 10 soybean call and 2 soybean put options.
The overnight trend for corn was 3/4 to one cent per bushel lower, soybeans 2-1/2 cents lower, wheat 3/4 to 1 cent lower, soyoil 0.04 to 0.05 cent per lb lower and soymeal 70 cents per ton lower.
